LESSON: FAITH AND GOD’S PROMISES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: THE BIBLE
Topic 2.1: Faith and God’s Promises

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Faith and God’s Promises
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you apply God’s promises in your daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the background to the call of Abraham
2. apply faith in different situations as exemplified by Abraham
3. explain the importance of God’s promises to Christians today
4. apply God’s promises in their daily lives
